findings.highlight: The old mage, waiting only for death to claim him
findings.evidenceJa: 死を待つだけだった老魔術師
findings.governingReading: 死を待つだけだった looks back to the prior bisected body contrasted with his presently intact laughter.
findings.explanation: The mage who had been left only to await death becomes a mage now waiting only for death.

findings.highlight: completely overrun by the bugs teeming over the walls
findings.evidenceJa: ガサガサと壁を這う虫の音
findings.governingReading: ガサガサと壁を這う虫の音 pairs a specific audible wall-crawling texture with rotten smell.
findings.explanation: The room dominated by rustling insect sound becomes a room physically overrun with bugs.

findings.governingReading: 何万 is the scale of room-filling insects that one stick cannot sweep away.
findings.explanation: Tens of thousands of insects become an unquantified swarm.

findings.evidenceJa: 好きな死に方を選ぶがよい
findings.governingReading: 好きな死に方を選ぶ turns every offered course into a fatal outcome, mocking his actual tactical agency.
findings.explanation: Choose a way to die becomes merely the choice is yours.
